termination.message: Return from COBYLA because the trust region radius reaches its lower bound.

inclusion_relationships.T_optimizer_total: inclusive of optimizer overhead and all objective evaluations
inclusion_relationships.T_objective_eval_total: inclusive of circuit build, transpilation, Aer, and expectation processing for objective evaluations
inclusion_relationships.T_final_evaluation: separate post-optimizer evaluation; do not add to T_optimizer_total
inclusion_relationships.T_total: wall-clock envelope; do not sum component metrics as an alternative
